stage0029_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オードリー$$
（It's been almost a month since I boarded this ship...）

stage0029_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$オードリー$$
（Neo Zeon shows no signs of movement, but
　I wonder if my disappearance caused confusion...）

stage0029_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$オードリー$$
（And then... just what am I planning to do here...）

stage0029_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シン$$
「Is that all right, $$バナージ$$?
　Leaving her alone like that?」

stage0029_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't know what to say to her
　at a time like this...」

stage0029_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't just give up like that.
　When a girl's feeling anxious, she's
　happy just to have someone with her」

stage0029_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シン$$
「You don't have to say anything.
　Just stay by $$オードリー$$'s side」

stage0029_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Never thought I'd hear $$シン$$ talk about a girl's heart」

stage0029_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ファ$$
「Then, $$シン$$...
　are you keeping in touch with $$ルナマリア$$ on $$プラント$$?」

stage0029_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シン$$
「Uh... well, things have been hectic lately...
　and she seems busy too...」

stage0029_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$エマ$$
「No excuses now.
　Isn't it true a girl wants someone by her side?」

stage0029_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's how it is, $$バナージ$$.
　Don't end up all talk like $$シン$$」

stage0029_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$リディ$$
「If $$バナージ$$'s going to bow out,
　I'll be the one to support her instead」

stage0029_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$リディ$$
「I know more about girls than I look.
　At least more than $$シン$$ does」

stage0029_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シン$$
「Then show us how it's done, Ensign」

stage0029_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't snap at him, $$シン$$.
　The Ensign's playing the fool on purpose
　just to light a fire under $$バナージ$$」

stage0029_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...$n, $$オードリー$$!
　Got a moment?」

stage0029_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That event the Volunteer Club's all going to,
　mind if we tag along?」

stage0029_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$n
「Understood.
　I'll let you know the meeting spot later」

stage0029_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（There, $$バナージ$$...
　Captain $$アムロ$$ went out of his way to help.
　Don't let his kindness go to waste）

stage0029_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$... let's go too.
　The Volunteer Club will be there as well,
　so I'm sure it'll be fun」

stage0029_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I'm sorry.
　I'm just not in the mood for that...」

stage0029_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're just going to think, you can do
　that anywhere. Let's go」

stage0029_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Go on and clear your head a little.
　I'll square it with $$アルベルト$$ myself」

stage0029_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（There it is again...
　$$オードリー$$ tenses up whenever
　Captain $$アムロ$$ speaks to her...）

stage0029_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$n
（Why does this girl...
　look at Captain $$アムロ$$ like that...）

stage0029_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text: ～ Earth Federation Forces Narashino Base, Festival ～

stage0029_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright, a festival!
　Let's have fun, everyone!」

stage0029_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「How embarrassing...!
　As a fellow Element, I'm ashamed!」

stage0029_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't be so uptight about it, $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　It's a special event, after all」

stage0029_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Stay away, you two-timer!
　You disgust me!」

stage0029_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$n
「Knock it off, $$アルト$$.
　As president, don't lose your spirit of service」

stage0029_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$甲児$$
「$n's right.
　Today's gathering is also about getting along
　with the Element folks, y'know」

stage0029_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even on his day off he's stressed out,
　rough being club president」

stage0029_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Still, I'm glad.
　Coming to this world left me full of worries,
　but I've made new friends like this」

stage0029_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（Plus there are so many hotties and cuties here...!）

stage0029_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$... that bad habit again...」

stage0029_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Never mind, never mind!
　Let's just enjoy the festival first!」

stage0029_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$モロイ$$
「So what's this festival even for?」

stage0029_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is Narashino Base, Earth Federation Forces.
　A thanksgiving festival for local goodwill」

stage0029_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A military event, huh...
　Figures, knowing you, it'd be something like this...」

stage0029_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$恭子$$
「Still, it's fun enough, Kana-chan.
　There's lots of food stalls too」

stage0029_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's not all.
　There's also an AS mock battle later, apparently」

stage0029_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Only you, Bro, and that military otaku
　$$ケンスケ$$, would enjoy something like this...!」

stage0029_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Nah, it's not just us, $$トウジ$$.
　My mentor $$風間$$'s here today too!」

stage0029_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Come to think of it, this event...
　$$風間$$'s the one who invited us, right?」

stage0029_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$恭子$$
「What's wrong, $$風間$$?
　You seem kind of down...」

stage0029_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Did something happen?
　If it'd help, we're happy to listen」

stage0029_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$恭子$$
「Still, I was surprised.
　I didn't know Sagara had so many friends outside school」

stage0029_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$宗介$$
「The Volunteer Club operates everywhere.
　They're acquaintances from there」

stage0029_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$恭子$$
「You even skip school to do that stuff.
　The Volunteer Club really is something」

stage0029_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　That is our mission」

stage0029_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Pathetic.
　An army meant to protect civilians, doing this...」

stage0029_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シン$$
「What's wrong with that?
　An army the people actually like, for once」

stage0029_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
Shinn
「I introduced myself at the meet-up, remember?
　I'm $$シン・アスカ$$.
　Good to meet you, $$カイエン$$」

stage0029_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I don't care for overly familiar men」

stage0029_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't say that.
　We're comrades now, so let's get along」

stage0029_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$シン$$... you seem to have
　taken a liking to that $$カイエン$$ guy」

stage0029_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He must relate to Cayenne wanting to protect his sister」

stage0029_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Does he have a younger sister too?」

stage0029_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never told you, so of course you didn't know.
　Don't worry about it, $$オードリー$$」

stage0029_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That feeling is where $$シン$$'s fight began.
　He's trying to end the war so no one else
　suffers what his sister did」

stage0029_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If $$シン$$ relates to $$カイエン$$,
　then $$バナージ$$'s more like that other one」

stage0029_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Um, $$ミコノ$$... want to get some crepes over there?」

stage0029_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Crepes, nice!
　Maybe I'll tag along too!」

stage0029_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah... if you press against me like that...!」

stage0029_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Hahaha!
　You're getting all flustered over me!」

stage0029_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ow, ow...
　I can't believe you tackled me like that...」

stage0029_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Sorry...!
　That was a bit rough of me!」

stage0029_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I-I'm fine...
　Thanks to you, I'm saved」

stage0029_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Thanks.
　Um... $$バナージ$$, was it?
　Let me treat you to a crepe」

stage0029_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Did you hear that, $$オードリー$$?
　Let's take him up on it」

stage0029_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But to accept charity from others...」

stage0029_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So stiff.
　Just relax and have some fun」

stage0029_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Even if you say that...」

stage0029_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Got it!
　You'd rather have something else, then?
　I'll go find something」

stage0029_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come too.
　...Wait here, $$オードリー$$」

stage0029_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$, and that $$バナージ$$ too,
　both frantic for a cute girl.
　Right, $$ミコノ$$?」

stage0029_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$赤城$$
「Oops, a pout doesn't suit a Lady」

stage0029_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Who are you?
　You're too familiar」

stage0029_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
Akagi
「Forgive my late introduction.
　I'm $$赤城龍之介$$, the Nerima Red Dragon」

stage0029_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Mister, you're Federation, right?
　Picking up girls at the festival?」

stage0029_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$赤城$$
「A challenge, right here...!
　Does that mean you'll keep me company?」

stage0029_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh, I was just trying to save her
　from your pickup artist claws...」

stage0029_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$赤城$$
「That reckless side is lovely too.
　Care to pilot an AS with me?」

stage0029_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That pickup line makes no sense...」

stage0029_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
Akagi
「If pickup artists are a problem,
　leave it to me, $$赤木駿介$$!」

stage0029_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Akagi there, Akagi here too...!
　An Akagi showdown, no way...!?」

stage0029_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Is this an endless mahjong genre!?」

stage0029_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$恭子$$
「W-what are you talking about, Kana...」

stage0029_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh, uh-ha-ha!
　Guess I picked up some bad signals...」

stage0029_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$赤城$$
「I see...
　So you're $$赤木駿介$$ of $$２１世紀警備保障$$」

stage0029_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$青山$$
「This guy... seems to know about you」

stage0029_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Oh... could it be that I'm famous?」

stage0029_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
Akagi
「Then let me introduce myself properly.
　I'm $$赤城龍之介$$, the Nerima Red Dragon」

stage0029_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$赤城$$
「No! Nerima Red Dragon!
　The crimson dragon!」

stage0029_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Why would Mr. Crimson Dragon know about me...?」

stage0029_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$赤城$$
「$$赤木駿介$$...
　Your nickname at the Defense Academy was Akaten...」

stage0029_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$飯塚$$
「I'm the one who taught him」

stage0029_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$赤城$$
「It's been a long time, Instructor $$飯塚$$!」

stage0029_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$飯塚$$
「It's been a while, both you Akagis」

stage0029_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That Mr. $$飯塚$$ is $$赤木$$'s mentor
　in robot piloting from his Defense Academy days」

stage0029_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$青山$$
「Since he's called an instructor,
　he must be a teacher to that $$赤城$$ too」

stage0029_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$飯塚$$
「That's right.
　Both Akagis are students of mine」

stage0029_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$赤城$$
「Instructor $$飯塚$$ told me about Akaten.
　Seems he's an even sloppier pilot than the rumors say」

stage0029_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$赤城$$
「...This is a good chance, Instructor.
　I'd like a mock battle with him, right here」

stage0029_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$赤城$$
「After all, against Narashino Base's AS,
　Nerima Base's win is a given anyway」

stage0029_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$飯塚$$
「...Very well.
　I'll square it with the base commander.
　What do you say, Akaten?」

stage0029_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$赤城$$
「Seems you've lost your nerve...
　Can't be helped, for a civilian」

stage0029_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's not it.
　I'm saying I can't use $$ダイ・ガード$$
　for something like that」

stage0029_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$赤木$$'s actually thinking before he talks!」

stage0029_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Now, don't say that, Akaten.
　This mock battle will mean something for you too.
　I'll get approval from Director $$大塚$$ myself」

stage0029_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$赤城$$
「Then it's decided.
　We'll face you with all of Nerima Red Dragon」

stage0029_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$赤城$$
「Gather however many you need too.
　We'll crush you utterly,
　right before Instructor $$飯塚$$'s eyes」

stage0029_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$飯塚$$
「But he has the skill to back it up.
　The skill, at least...」

stage0029_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$恭子$$
「You know that radish guy, $$風間$$?」

stage0029_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$風間$$
「The Narashino and Nerima base AS mock battles
　are an annual thing, but so far Narashino Base
　has lost every single one...」

stage0029_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Could it be that you're
　the son of Narashino Base's clerk, $$風間$$?」

stage0029_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$恭子$$
「I see...
　So you've been down because your dad's
　Narashino Base keeps losing」

stage0029_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「So that's why he was so confident
　and looking down on people」

stage0029_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$風間$$
「Please, $$赤木$$!
　Beat him to a pulp!」

stage0029_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sorry, $$風間$$.
　I can't do that」

stage0029_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$風間$$
「Why not!?
　Is it because you're Akaten, so you lack confidence!?」

stage0029_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's not it.
　This is training, not a fight.
　So don't throw anger or hatred into it」

stage0029_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$赤木$$
「But I will win, no matter what!
　A guy like that won't get it
　until he's had a hard lesson」

stage0029_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$風間$$
「Yes!
　I'll cheer for you with everything I've got!」

stage0029_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$赤木$$
「Now that's settled, let's get ready!
　Come on, $$いぶき$$, $$青山$$!」

stage0029_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$青山$$
「It always comes to this, doesn't it」

stage0029_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is getting exciting, $$ミコノ$$, $$オードリー$$!
　We need front row seats for this!」

stage0029_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That hot-blooded $$赤木$$ over there
　is a comrade we'll be fighting alongside,
　so we've got to cheer him on!」

stage0029_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$オードリー$$
（A good opportunity.
　Let me see for myself
　what the Federation's rank and file are like）

stage0029_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Man, this is thrilling!
　A clash of pride between the army and a company!」

stage0029_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Bro $$宗介$$, who do you think will win?」

stage0029_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$宗介$$
「With the so-called Red Dragon's strength unknown,
　I withhold careless speculation for now」

stage0029_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$宗介$$
「But even $$ダイ・ガード$$ will likely
　struggle against an AS unit
　operated with proper organization」

stage0029_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You there!
　Where were you when a maiden was in trouble!?」

stage0029_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry.
　I was handling a personal matter」

stage0029_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And another thing, Sousuke!
　You always brag about being a pro,
　but are you really doing your job right?」

stage0029_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Aren't you actually holding back
　$$アルト$$ and $n and the others?」

stage0029_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$宗介$$
「If you're going to say that, it can't be helped」

stage0029_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「A good opportunity.
　Watch my fighting up close」

stage0029_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text: ～ Earth Federation Forces Narashino Base, Festival ～

stage0029_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Thank you, $$赤木$$.
　Thanks to you and Narashino Base's troops,
　I've learned what I was missing」

stage0029_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$赤木$$
「Glad to hear it.
　From now on, we're comrades fighting for peace」

stage0029_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「Besides... we're both $$赤木$$,
　so let's drop the formalities」

stage0029_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Seems things worked out.
　Though it's a bit creepy...」

stage0029_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$青山$$
「So it all went according to $$飯塚$$'s plan?」

stage0029_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$飯塚$$
「Only a fool can match a fool, after all.
　But this should help the Red Dragon crowd
　grow up a little too」

stage0029_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$青山$$
「Seems they're not the only ones who grew up」

stage0029_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah...
　Somewhere inside, I used to look down on
　the people at Dad's Narashino Base, but...」

stage0029_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah.
　So you should be proud of your dad too」

stage0029_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$恭子$$
「Speaking of which, Kana...
　Where were you all this time?」

stage0029_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$風間$$
「Sagara was gone the whole time too...」

stage0029_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$恭子$$
「Could it be a secret date, just you two?」

stage0029_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh, uh-hahahaha!
　No way, that's not it!」

stage0029_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「More importantly!
　All that commotion today left
　trash everywhere around here!」

stage0029_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アルト$$
「Attention all, from the Volunteer Club chief!
　We now begin our cleanup volunteer work!
　I expect non-members to pitch in too!」

stage0029_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Roger!
　Leave digging the trash pit to me!」

stage0029_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「A dirty environment is bad for discipline too.
　Let's give it a thorough cleaning!」

stage0029_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's been a while since I saw you laugh, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0029_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Federation soldiers fight to protect
　civilians too. I'll do what I can as well.」

stage0029_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Glad to hear it, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0029_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$アマタ$$.
　Maybe it's thanks to the takoyaki
　we bought together.」

stage0029_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$オードリー$$
「No, takoyaki simply must be from Munzo.」

stage0029_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I once read a story like that.」

stage0029_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't go deciding that all by yourself!」

stage0029_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$宗介$$
「What are you doing, Chidori?
　That hurts.」

stage0029_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, you!
　Why did you bring that thing
　of yours to a place like this!?」

stage0029_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$風間$$ told me this event was meant
　to show citizens our arms and build rapport.」

stage0029_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Even so, why bring something that absurd...!」

stage0029_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ボン太くん#robot$$, huh...
　If so, it should be in the Quarter's hangar...」

stage0029_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「B-$$ボン太くん#robot$$ already left!
　He asked us to say hi for him!」

stage0029_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Look at $$レイ#333$$'s eyes!
　Are you really going to crush the dreams
　of a girl who adores $$ボン太くん#robot$$ so purely!?）

stage0029_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$宗介$$
（I see...
　So he's taken a liking to $$ボン太くん#robot$$...）

stage0029_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$かなめ$$
（That's right.
　Sure, there was a bit of a runaway moment,
　but your original goal was met after all.）

stage0029_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$宗介$$
（Then I'll reinforce its equipment
　so it's even more well-liked.）

stage0029_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$宗介$$
（First, mount a rocket launcher on the back,
　fit both arms with two Gatling guns each...
　then add more propellant tanks...）

stage0029_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't you dare crush a girl's dreeeams!!」

stage0029_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text: ～ EFF Far East Branch, Director's Office ～

stage0029_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$レディ$$
「...Now, I'll announce the $$大統領$$'s decision.」

stage0029_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$レディ$$
「The new unit formed from $$プリベンター$$ is guaranteed
　the right to act anywhere, anytime, whenever it
　serves humanity's peace and progress.」

stage0029_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$レディ$$
「Personnel and equipment are left entirely
　to our discretion, and acting independent
　of the EFF chain of command is permitted.」

stage0029_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So our work is finally officially recognized.」

stage0029_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$オットー$$
「Having gained this moral backing
　is a fine thing indeed.」

stage0029_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$レディ$$
「But the road ahead is difficult.」

stage0029_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Earth-colony conflict, $$マーティアル$$'s scheming,
　the Demon Emperor, the Angels, the Abductors...
　and the mystery enemy 'UG'...」

stage0029_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$大塚$$
「But the strength to break through that
　difficulty has gathered here. There is hope.」

stage0029_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$...
　Will we be calling ourselves $$プリベンター$$ from now on?」

stage0029_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$レディ$$
「No...
　For the new independent unit, I'd like to
　use words a certain person left behind.」

stage0029_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$オットー$$
「And who might that person be...」

stage0029_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$レディ$$
「It's 《$$エルガン・ローディック$$》.」

stage0029_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The man captivated by 《$$黒の英知$$》,
　one of 《$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$》...」

stage0029_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The one who wished for peace and progress
　in $$ＡＤＷ$$, and laid its cornerstone, right?」

stage0029_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$レディ$$
「After the $$再世戦争$$ ended, $$プリベンター$$
　traced Mr. Roddick's footsteps, and in doing
　so, we found these words of his.」

stage0029_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$レディ$$
「'To protect this beautiful, blue star,
　I dearly wish that those who fight, crossing
　the Earth-space divide, would join hands.' ...」

stage0029_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I see...
　Those words sound just like him...」

stage0029_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$レディ$$
「And I added a 'Z' for unwavering resolve...」

stage0029_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Z Busters Link
　Universe & Earth...
　Its name: Z-BLUE （Zee-Blue）.」

stage0029_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$レディ$$
「If there are other opinions, I'd like to hear them.」

stage0029_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$レディ$$
「From this point on, we begin operating
　as '$c'.」

stage0029_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$...
　A unit that carries on their will while
　adding new comrades... So, $c, huh.」

stage0029_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$大塚$$
「I'm counting on you, $c.
　Fight for this blue star.」

stage0029_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$大塚$$
「Just what business brings you here?
　I wasn't told you'd be visiting.」

stage0029_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Have you forgotten, Director $$大塚$$?
　That EFF Supreme Command holds the right
　to freely inspect every theater army.」

stage0029_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$テッサ$$
（$$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　The face of Earth supremacism within the EFF...）

stage0029_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$オットー$$
（His nickname: the tail-end of $$ティターンズ$$,
　a leftover scrap of 《$$ロゴス$$》...
　They say he's always griping at Londo Bell too）

stage0029_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$大塚$$
「So then, Brig. Gen. $$サイガス$$...
　Supreme Command judged that this Far East
　Branch needs an inspection, is that it?」

stage0029_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Not the Far East Branch itself.
　It's about the newly approved independent unit.」

stage0029_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$レディ$$
（Impossible...
　Has a direct order from the $$大統領$$
　already leaked to Supreme Command...?）

stage0029_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$サイガス$$
「What's wrong, $$レディ・アン$$?
　You don't look well.」

stage0029_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Since the $$大統領$$ approved it, Supreme
　Command won't interfere with its existence.」

stage0029_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$サイガス$$
「But since you're outside the Federation's
　chain of command, if you act against the
　Earth Federation's interests, be prepared.」

stage0029_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$サイガス$$
「It's a warning, Director $$大塚$$.」

stage0029_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$サイガス$$
「The day of talks between the $$大統領$$
　and Neo Zeon's $$ハマーン$$ is coming soon.
　Until then, please refrain from acting alone.」

stage0029_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$サイガス・エイロニー$$...
　Just how much backing does he have...」

stage0029_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$大塚$$
「To apply pressure so openly...
　We'll need to be careful.」

stage0029_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But our... $c's fight has begun.
　There's no turning back, no stopping now.」

stage0029_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That's right.
　This fog of malice covering the world...
　We must clear it away.」

stage0029_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$レディ$$
「I've already reached out to sympathetic
　organizations and members for their help.」

stage0029_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$レディ$$
「Once $c starts fighting,
　they'll surely join the fight too.」

stage0029_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$大塚$$
「There's anxiety, but there's hope too.
　I'll be counting on your hard fight.」

stage0029_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary of me.
　I... I get hurt, you know.」

stage0029_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$カレン$$
「S-sorry... But there's something about you
　I just can't let my guard down around...」

stage0029_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh no...!
　And I prepared a present for Master $$カレン$$ today!」

stage0029_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah well, Master $$カレン$$'s fury in that battle
　with the harassing superior made a fine Z-Chip.」

stage0029_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's worth 100 Z!
　I'll add it to the unit's stock.」

stage0029_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$カレン$$
「Never mind that, what's with this bunny suit!?」

stage0029_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought that if you fought while
　wearing it, you might keep generating
　more Z-Chips going forward...」

stage0029_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And if teenage boys happened to see it
　and generate some Z-Chips too...」

stage0029_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$カレン$$
「No way!
　Your harassment's worse than $$カン・ユー$$'s!」

stage0029_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I see...
　And here I thought it was such a good idea.」

stage0029_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$カレン$$
「You were in on this too, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!」

stage0029_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't get so mad.
　A bunny needs some charm to pull it off.」

stage0029_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s popular with all ages,
　but what exactly makes him so charming...」

stage0029_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've got the same warm-toned, roundish body,
　yet somehow I just don't do well with the ladies.」

stage0029_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Maybe I should add a distinctive verbal
　tic or something, to make my appeal clearer...」

stage0029_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or should I lean harder into the mascot-
　suit look, to seem more approachable...」

stage0029_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At the very least, I think I'm cuter than
　some stone-faced guy showing up...」

stage0029_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Anyway, enough silly talk,
　let's get down to business!
　So today too, let's go... Business, business!」
